waiting_period_initial.value: A 30-day waiting period applies to all treatments except accidents.
waiting_period_initial.clause: 2. Initial 30-Day Waiting Period A waiting period of 30 days shall apply to all medical treatments, except in case of accidental injury occurring during the policy period.

waiting_period_preexisting.value: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 continuous months.
waiting_period_preexisting.clause: 3. Waiting Period for Pre-Existing Conditions Pre-existing diseases and their complications will be covered after a waiting period of 36 continuous months under this Policy.

waiting_period_specific.value: A 24-month waiting period applies to specific conditions like cataract, hernia, hydrocele, joint replacement, and gall stones.
waiting_period_specific.clause: 4. Specific Disease Waiting Period (2 Years) A waiting period of 24 months of continuous coverage applies for specific illnesses: cataract, hernia, hydrocele, joint replacement surgery, and gall stones.
